b: I have been told to seek a diagnosis by almost all of my friends at one point or another in my life. All of the people that I do know that have ADHD have told me to get a diagnosis and get on medication. I just have a lot of concerns about it. One of which is, can I ever get off of Ritalin/Concerta etc etc, years on down the line if I feel like I want to? I have this horrible concern of being chemically dependent on a drug that alters my mental state. I know it probably sounds silly or conspiratorial, but I quite like the way I am now, with all its flaws, and I'm extremely worried about going onto medication that might change who and how I am, with little hope of ever getting back to what I consider 'normal'. I don't mean this to cause any offence to those that are on medication, it's just my number one concern about getting diagnosed. Any advice or anecdotes is really, really appreciated.
